✓ Compact operator.fact: In functional analysis, a branch of mathematics, a compact operator is a linear operator that behaves, in several important respects, like a finite-dimensional operator such as a matrix. Compact operators partly restore this finite-dimensional behavior by sending bounded sets to sets whose closures are compact, or equivalently, in normed spaces, by sending bounded sequences to sequences with convergent subsequences.
